repos.name: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
repos.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
repos.one_liner: A modular, plugin-based architecture designed to standardize and extend the capabilities of DeepSeek models.
bullets: Built on a TypeScript-based plugin architecture that treats every feature as an extensible module.
Provides a unified interface for integrating diverse AI-driven workflows into a single ecosystem.
Serves as the foundational infrastructure for the rapidly growing DeepSeek plugin ecosystem.
Enables developers to build highly customized agentic environments with shared state and logic.

repos.name: internet-court/internet-court-skill
repos.description: The trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce — natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, x402 payments, escrow, and dispute resolution as one open, catch-all Agent Skill / Claude Code plugin.
repos.one_liner: A trust and commerce layer for agent-to-agent interactions, integrating payments, permissions, and dispute resolution.
bullets: Implements ERC-7710 for delegated agent permissions and x402 payment protocols for machine-to-machine transactions.
Provides a standardized 'Agent Skill' for handling escrow and natural-language mandates in autonomous commerce.
Addresses the critical need for governance and dispute resolution in the emerging AI agent economy.
Designed to be compatible with Claude Code and other major agentic frameworks.

repos.name: ifixai-ai/iFixAi
repos.description: Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.
repos.one_liner: An independent auditing framework designed to verify that AI agents are executing their intended tasks correctly.
bullets: Utilizes a Python-based auditing engine to monitor agent behavior and output against predefined mandates.
Supports both human-in-the-loop and autonomous self-auditing capabilities for continuous verification.
Focuses on the 'Agent Economy' by providing a trust layer to ensure reliability in automated workflows.
Essential for enterprise use cases where agentic compliance and task accuracy are non-negotiable.

repos.name: unslothai/unsloth
repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.one_liner: High-performance framework for efficient fine-tuning and local inference of state-of-the-art LLMs.
bullets: Optimized for memory efficiency and speed, significantly reducing the hardware requirements for training large models.
Supports a wide range of architectures including DeepSeek-V4, Qwen, and Gemma, making it a versatile tool for custom model development.
Provides a local UI for managing training runs and diffusion model deployment.
Ideal for quant researchers and developers building domain-specific models on consumer-grade hardware.

repos.name: microsoft/data-formulator
repos.description: 🪄 Data Formulator is an interactive AI-powered data analysis system makes it easy to connect, explore and visualize data.
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered interactive system for data exploration, cleaning, and visualization.
bullets: Combines LLM-driven natural language processing with structured data transformation pipelines.
Automates the process of data cleaning and chart generation, reducing the manual overhead of exploratory data analysis.
Integrates directly into data workflows to provide rapid insights from raw datasets.
Useful for fintech analysts and data scientists needing to bridge the gap between unstructured data and actionable visualizations.
